train_rq_centroids: train a residual quantizer on train and validation datasets and return centroids across distributed processes
apply_rq_on_vectors: train a residual quantizer on training vectors and apply quantization to both train and validation sets
TorchRQ_quantize: quantize input vectors through multiple residual quantization stages and return quantized output or codes
TorchSingleVQ_encode: encode input vectors into discrete codes by finding nearest codebook centroids using pairwise distances
StackOfFaissRQ_train_static_rq: train a stack of FAISS residual quantizers on input data and return the quantized output
